# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.6

Version 1.4.6 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.5

- **Placing the gyroid 키다리팀바 토용 no longer crashes the game** (Android, 64-bit Windows and Linux).
  - **The problem:** its sound script calls five levels deep, one more than the sound player's call stack holds.
    On the GameCube the extra entry lands where the game finds it again; on 64-bit builds it also overwrote the
    stack's depth, and the sound player jumped to nowhere. A placed one could crash the game again each time its
    sound played. The 32-bit builds were not affected.
  - **The fix:** the stack has room for more levels on the PC and Android.
- **Save now**: **Ctrl+S** on PC, or **SAVE** left of START on the touch gamepad (the chat
  button stays on the right).
  - It also works in your house's rooms and with the autosave off.
  - A notice says it saved, or why it cannot yet: in a conversation or a menu, in the middle of an action, on the
    island, or on the first day before you have met a villager.
  - While Ctrl is held, S (walk down by default) does not move the player.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.6 can be in the same room.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.6-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.6-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.6-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.6-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- The gyroid, with a script that goes into the player's house and places 0x1730 from the pockets (Linux):
  - 64-bit, before: crash (segfault in the sound player) at the placement;
  - 64-bit, after: the gyroid stands in the room and the game goes on;
  - 32-bit: fine before and after.
- Save now (Linux):
  - SAVE on the touch gamepad, outdoors and in the room right after placing a gyroid: "Saved." both times.
    Loaded again, the room has the gyroid, which only that save could have kept.
  - Ctrl+S as real key presses: saved, and the player stayed where they stood.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.6, versionCode 10406).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
